name: @bunizao/ontrack
description: Terminal-first CLI for OnTrack and Doubtfire

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-output.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/mark-cli-executable.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node .build/tests/harness.js
scripts.test:bun: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun .build/tests/harness.js
scripts.test:golden: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/golden-run.mjs
scripts.test:golden:update: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/golden-update.mjs
scripts.verify:live: npm run build && node dist/cli.js auth check --json
scripts.coverage:domain: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/check-domain-coverage.mjs
